title: Efficacy of Tecovirimat for the Treatment of Mpox Virus Infection in Humans: Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
abstract: ABSTRACT Tecovirimat has been widely used for the treatment of mpox despite limited evidence supporting its efficacy. We conducted a systematic review and meta‐analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) to evaluate the efficacy and safety of tecovirimat for this purpose. PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials were searched from inception to June 5, 2026 for RCTs comparing tecovirimat with placebo or standard care in patients with laboratory‐confirmed mpox. Primary outcomes were time to clinical resolution of skin lesions, clinical resolution by day 28–29, and 28‐day all‐cause mortality. Hazard ratios (HRs) and risk ratios (RRs) were pooled using random‐effects models with restricted maximum likelihood estimation and Hartung–Knapp–Sidik–Jonkman adjustment. Risk of bias was assessed using RoB 2 and certainty of evidence using GRADE. Two low‐risk‐of‐bias RCTs involving 941 participants were included. Tecovirimat did not shorten the time to clinical resolution of skin lesions compared with placebo (HR 1.10, 95% CI 0.52–2.31, GRADE: moderate) or increase the lesion resolution by day 28–29 (RR 1.00, 95% CI 0.92–1.08, GRADE: high). No statistical heterogeneity was observed (I 2 = 0% for both outcomes). Mortality at day 28 was rare in both trials, precluding meta‐analysis. Virological clearance, pain‐related outcomes, and serious adverse events were also comparable between treatment groups. In conclusion, current randomized evidence does not support routine tecovirimat use to accelerate clinical recovery or improve mortality rates in patients with mpox, while further evidence is needed to determine whether selected high‐risk populations may benefit from antiviral therapy.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis assesses the efficacy and safety of tecovirimat for treating mpox virus infection in humans. Two low-risk-of-bias RCTs involving 941 participants were included, comparing tecovirimat with placebo or standard care. The primary outcomes were time to clinical resolution of skin lesions and 28-day all-cause mortality. Tecovirimat did not significantly improve clinical resolution or reduce mortality. Virological clearance, pain-related outcomes, and serious adverse events were comparable between groups. The review concludes that current evidence does not support routine tecovirimat use for accelerating recovery or improving survival in mpox patients, while further research is needed to determine potential benefits in high-risk populations.

title_zh: 特考韦瑞 对人类 猴痘病毒 感染的 治疗 效果:随机对照试验的系统综述和荟萃分析
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Tecovirimat has been widely used for the treatment of mpox despite limited evidence supporting its efficacy. We conducted a systematic review and meta‐analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) to evaluate the efficacy and safety of tecovirimat for this purpose. PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials were searched from inception to June 5, 2026 for RCTs comparing tecovirimat with placebo or standard care in patients with laboratory‐confirmed mpox. Primary outcomes were time to clinical resolution of skin lesions, clinical resolution by day 28–29, and 28‐day all‐cause mortality. Hazard ratios (HRs) and risk ratios (RRs) were pooled using random‐effects models with restricted maximum likelihood estimation and Hartung–Knapp–Sidik–Jonkman adjustment. Risk of bias was assessed using RoB 2 and certainty of evidence using GRADE. Two low‐risk‐of‐bias RCTs involving 941 participants were included. Tecovirimat did not shorten the time to clinical resolution of skin lesions compared with placebo (HR 1.10, 95% CI 0.52–2.31, GRADE: moderate) or increase the lesion resolution by day 28–29 (RR 1.00, 95% CI 0.92–1.08, GRADE: high). No statistical heterogeneity was observed (I 2 = 0% for both outcomes). Mortality at day 28 was rare in both trials, precluding meta‐analysis. Virological clearance, pain‐related outcomes, and serious adverse events were also comparable between treatment groups. In conclusion, current randomized evidence does not support routine tecovirimat use to accelerate clinical recovery or improve mortality rates in patients with mpox, while further evidence is needed to determine whether selected high‐risk populations may benefit from antiviral therapy.

title: Unraveling the Transmission Dynamics and Evolutionary Trajectory of Mpox in South Korea: 2022–2025 Outbreak
abstract: The 2022 monkeypox (mpox) outbreak, driven by clade IIb monkeypox virus (MPXV), was facilitated by human-to-human transmission, particularly within heavy-tailed sexual networks. APOBEC3-associated mutations have been a prominent feature of MPXV genomic evolution during the global outbreak. National genomic data were collected from clinical samples by the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency to examine the transmission dynamics and molecular evolution of MPXV. Target enrichment-based next-generation sequencing was used to generate high-quality genomes. Mutation profiling was used to identify key genetic changes; clustering based on common variants provided insights into national transmission dynamics and molecular evolution. Analysis of mpox-positive samples revealed the linkage of most cases to sub-lineage C.1 and a few cases to C.1.1. Genomic clustering revealed an uneven distribution of cases, with a dominant cluster accounting for a substantial proportion of domestic transmission while most other cluster remained relatively limited in size, consistent with heterogeneous transmission patterns. APOBEC3-associated mutations progressively accumulated during the outbreak and were frequently observed in genomic regions associated with viral structural integrity and cell-to-cell transmission and host-modulation, indicating continued genomic diversification during human-to-human transmission. Together with the dominance of localized clusters, these findings suggest heterogeneous transmission patterns and the possible contribution of epidemiologically unrecognized transmission to the spread of MPXV in South Korea. These results underscore value of integrating genomic surveillance and targeted interventions to characterize transmission patterns and monitor viral genomic changes of potential biological or public health relevance.

APOBEC3-associated mutations have been a prominent feature of MPXV genomic evolution during the global outbreak. National genomic data were collected from clinical samples by the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency to examine the transmission dynamics and molecular evolution of MPXV. Target enrichment-based next-generation sequencing was used to generate high-quality genomes. Mutation profiling was used to identify key genetic changes; clustering based on common variants provided insights into national transmission dynamics and molecular evolution. Analysis of mpox-positive samples revealed the linkage of most cases to sub-lineage C.1 and a few cases to C.1.1. Genomic clustering revealed an uneven distribution of cases, with a dominant cluster accounting for a substantial proportion of domestic transmission while most other cluster remained relatively limited in size, consistent with heterogeneous transmission patterns. APOBEC3-associated mutations progressively accumulated during the outbreak and were frequently observed in genomic regions associated with viral structural integrity and cell-to-cell transmission and host-modulation, indicating continued genomic diversification during human-to-human transmission. Together with the dominance of localized clusters, these findings suggest heterogeneous transmission patterns and the possible contribution of epidemiologically unrecognized transmission to the spread of MPXV in South Korea. These results underscore value of integrating genomic surveillance and targeted interventions to characterize transmission patterns and monitor viral genomic changes of potential biological or public health relevance.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in South Korea from 2022 to 2025, utilizing national genomic data collected from clinical samples to examine the transmission dynamics and molecular evolution of MPXV.
analysis.methods: High-quality genomes of MPXV were generated using target enrichment-based next-generation sequencing, and mutation profiling was employed to identify key genetic changes and cluster cases based on common variants.

The study underscores the value of genomic surveillance in understanding mpox transmission and evolution, but its reliance on genetic data limits the strength of the conclusions. The evidence is moderate, as it does not include direct epidemiological observations.

abstract_zh: 2022年的猴痘(猴痘)暴发是由IIb分支猴痘病毒(MPXV)驱动的,并且在性传播网络中通过人际传播传播得以传播。在此次全球暴发期间,与APOBEC3相关的突变是MPXV基因组进化的一个显著特征。韩国疾病控制与预防机构从临床样本中收集了国家基因组数据,以研究MPXV的传播动态及其分子进化。采用基于靶向富集的下一代测序技术生成高质量的基因组,并利用突变分析来识别关键的遗传变化;根据常见变异进行聚类分析,提供了关于国家传播动态和分子进化的见解。对猴痘阳性样本的分析显示,大多数病例与C.1亚系相关,少数病例与C.1.1亚系相关。基因组聚类分析揭示了病例分布的不均匀性,其中主导聚类占国内传播的相当大比例,而其他聚类则相对较小,这与异质性传播模式一致。与APOBEC3相关的突变在暴发期间逐渐积累,并且在与病毒结构完整性、细胞间传播和宿主调节相关的基因组区域中频繁出现,表明在人际传播过程中MPXV基因组持续发生多样化。结合主导的局部聚类,这些发现表明韩国的暴发具有异质性传播模式,并且可能有未被流行病学识别的传播途径对MPXV的传播有所贡献。这些结果强调了将基因组监测与针对性干预措施相结合的重要性,以更好地描述传播模式并监测可能具有生物学或公共卫生意义的病毒基因组变化。该研究的局限性在于其依赖于临床样本的基因组数据,可能无法完全代表所有传播途径。由于研究主要集中在遗传数据而非直接的流行病学观察,其证据强度中等。

title: Paediatric mpox during Sierra Leone’s 2024 to 2025 clade IIb outbreak: A national surveillance and outbreak-investigation study of 415 children
abstract: BACKGROUND: Evidence on paediatric mpox during contemporary African clade IIb outbreaks remains limited. We described paediatric cases in Sierra Leone's 2024-2025 clade IIb G.1 outbreak by person, time, and place and examined clinical care, outcomes, vaccination records, and documented exposures. METHODOLOGY/PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: We conducted a retrospective descriptive study using the national District Health Information Software 2 (DHIS2) mpox database, supplemented by patient charts and outbreak-investigation forms. Among 5,466 cases with recorded age, 415 (7.6%) were children younger than 15 years; 188 (45.3%) were aged 0-4 years, 121 (29.2%) were aged 5-9 years, and 106 (25.5%) were aged 10-14 years. Of 415 paediatric cases, 411 were laboratory-confirmed. Outcome was recorded for 261 children; three died (1.1%, exact 95% CI 0.2 to 3.3). Care location was recorded for 285 children; 216 (75.8%) received hospital care for isolation, clinical management, or both. Three sporadic paediatric cases of mpox-like illness were reported from 2017 through 2024; notifications then rose rapidly from April 2025 and peaked in May. Western Area Urban accounted for 195/413 cases with known district; crude notified paediatric rates were highest in Western Area Urban, Koinadugu, and Falaba. Household or caregiving contact was the most common documented exposure among 246 classifiable investigation forms (141, 57.3%). Mpox vaccination status was recorded for 27/54 cases aged 12-14 years; six were vaccinated. CONCLUSIONS/SIGNIFICANCE: Children were not spared during Sierra Leone's clade IIb outbreak. Response plans should include children in case finding, contact follow-up, clinical care, and vaccination assessment. DHIS2 should capture epidemiologic links, clinical outcomes, vaccine eligibility and status, and potential exposure settings through standardised fields.

A retrospective descriptive study was conducted using the national DHIS2 mpox database and patient charts, identifying 415 children under 15 years old among 5,466 total cases. abstract_zh: 背景:关于当代非洲IIb簇暴发在儿童中的证据仍然有限。我们根据时间、地点和个体描述了塞拉利昂2024-2025年IIb簇G.1 暴发的儿童病例,并检查了临床护理、结果、疫苗接种记录以及记录的暴露情况。方法/主要发现:我们使用国家District Health Information Software 2(DHIS2)猴痘数据库进行了回顾性描述性研究,并辅以患者病历和暴发调查表。在5,466例有年龄记录的病例中,415例(7.6%)为15岁以下儿童;其中0-4岁儿童有188例(45.3%),5-9岁儿童有121例(29.2%),10-14岁儿童有106例(25.5%)。在415例儿童病例中,411例为实验室确诊。261名儿童的结果被记录,其中3例死亡(1.1%,精确95%置信区间0.2至3.3)。285名儿童的护理地点被记录,其中216例(75.8%)接受了医院护理以进行隔离、临床管理或两者兼有。2017年至2024年间报告了3例与猴痘相似的儿童病例;然后从2025年4月开始迅速增加,并在5月达到高峰。在已知区县的413例病例中,西方城市区占195例;粗略的儿童通知发病率在西方城市区、Koinadugu和Falaba最高。在246份可归类的调查表中,家庭或照顾者接触是最常见的记录暴露方式(141例,57.3%)。在54例12-14岁儿童中,记录了27例疫苗接种状态,其中6例已接种疫苗。结论/意义:在塞拉利昂的IIb簇ZXQQTERMXQXZ暴发期间,儿童并未幸免。应对计划应包括儿童在病例发现、接触随访、临床护理和疫苗接种评估中的参与。DHIS2应通过标准化字段捕捉流行病学联系、临床结果、疫苗资格和状态以及潜在的暴露环境。

analysis_zh.main_results: 在5,466例有年龄记录的病例中,415例(7.6%)为15岁以下儿童;其中188例(45.3%)年龄为0-4岁,121例(29.2%)年龄为5-9岁,106例(25.5%)年龄为10-14岁。261名儿童的结果被记录,其中3例死亡(1.1%,精确95%置信区间0.2至3.3)。285名儿童的护理地点被记录,其中216例(75.8%)接受了医院护理以进行隔离、临床管理或两者兼有。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结论/意义:在塞拉利昂的IIb类暴发期间,儿童并未幸免。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 应对计划应包括儿童在病例发现、接触随访、临床护理和疫苗接种评估中的参与。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告研究设计的局限性。

title: A three-generation mpox cluster in Chongqing, 2024: transmission chain investigation and phylogenetic characterization
abstract: BACKGROUND: In recent years, mpox has emerged as a significant public health concern, with the potential for both local and international spread. This study aimed to describe a three-generation mpox cluster and characterize its epidemiological features. METHODS: A three-generation mpox cluster was reported between August 19 and 23, 2024, in Chongqing China. Field epidemiology investigations were conducted to identify high-risk exposures and transmission routes and to guide the public health response. Rash lesion samples, anal swabs, pharyngeal swabs, and blood samples were collected from the cases for real-time polymerase chain reaction testing. Genome sequencing was performed to determine the MPXV clade. RESULTS: The cluster comprised three men who have sex with men, aged in their 40s, 30s, and 20s, respectively. All cases had mild symptoms, including perianal or genital rashes. .Case B was exposed to Case A through condomless sexual intercourse four days before symptom onset in Case A. Epidemiological investigation supported transmission through condomless sexual contact along the Case A → B → C chain in August 2024. Samples from Cases A and C were successfully sequenced and identified as MPXV clade IIb, lineage E.3. CONCLUSIONS: This three-generation mpox cluster was caused by MPXV clade IIb and was transmitted through condomless sexual contact. The findings suggest possible pre-symptomatic transmission of MPXV. Health education and sustained surveillance are essential for mpox prevention and control.

title_zh: 重庆2024年一个三代猴痘病毒集群:猴痘病毒传播链调查及系统发育特征分析
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: In recent years, mpox has emerged as a significant public health concern, with the potential for both local and international spread. This study aimed to describe a three-generation mpox cluster and characterize its epidemiological features. METHODS: A three-generation mpox cluster was reported between August 19 and 23, 2024, in Chongqing China. Field epidemiology investigations were conducted to identify high-risk exposures and transmission routes and to guide the public health response. Rash lesion samples, anal swabs, pharyngeal swabs, and blood samples were collected from the cases for real-time polymerase chain reaction testing. Genome sequencing was performed to determine the MPXV clade. RESULTS: The cluster comprised three men who have sex with men, aged in their 40s, 30s, and 20s, respectively. All cases had mild symptoms, including perianal or genital rashes. .Case B was exposed to Case A through condomless sexual intercourse four days before symptom onset in Case A. Epidemiological investigation supported transmission through condomless sexual contact along the Case A → B → C chain in August 2024. Samples from Cases A and C were successfully sequenced and identified as MPXV clade IIb, lineage E.3. CONCLUSIONS: This three-generation mpox cluster was caused by MPXV clade IIb and was transmitted through condomless sexual contact. The findings suggest possible pre-symptomatic transmission of MPXV. Health education and sustained surveillance are essential for mpox prevention and control.
abstract_zh: 背景:近年来,猴痘病毒已成为重要的公共卫生问题,具有本地和国际传播的潜力。本研究旨在描述一个三代猴痘病毒集群,并对其流行病学特征进行分析。方法:2024年8月19日至23日,中国重庆市报告了一例三代猴痘病毒集群。开展了现场调查以识别高风险暴露和传播途径,并指导公共卫生应对措施。从病例中采集了皮疹样本、肛拭子、咽拭子和血液样本进行实时聚合酶链反应检测。进行了基因组测序以确定猴痘病毒(MPXV)的簇类。结果:该集群包括三名男性同性性行为者,年龄分别为40多岁、30多岁和20多岁。所有病例均表现为轻度症状,包括肛周或生殖器皮疹。病例B在病例A出现症状前四天通过无套性行为暴露于病例A。流行病学调查显示,2024年8月病例A→病例B→病例C的传播链可能通过无套性接触发生。病例A和病例C的样本成功进行了基因组测序,并被鉴定为猴痘病毒IIb簇,E.3谱系。结论:该三代猴痘病毒集群由猴痘病毒IIb簇引起,通过无套性接触传播。研究结果提示猴痘病毒可能存在无症状期的传播。健康教育和持续的监测对于猴痘病毒的预防和控制至关重要。

title: Infection of macrophages by mpox virus activates inflammasome and cell death, informing multitarget therapeutic strategies
abstract: Severe mpox virus (MPXV) infection causes immunopathological manifestations in patients. Here, we provide clinical evidence of MPXV-induced inflammation in a large patient cohort and demonstrate direct macrophage infection in skin tissues from an autopsied mpox patient. In human macrophages, MPXV efficiently enters, replicates, and produces infectious particles. Infection activates both AIM2 and NLRP3 inflammasomes, triggering inflammatory responses and three forms of programmed cell death: pyroptosis, apoptosis, and necroptosis. Inflammasome inhibition reduces MPXV-induced inflammation and cell death without affecting viral replication. Screening clinically used anti-inflammatory drugs identified flufenamic acid, which suppresses MPXV-induced inflammation and cell death and, unexpectedly, also inhibits viral infection. Combined treatment with flufenamic acid and the antiviral brincidofovir further enhances suppression of viral infection, inflammatory response, and cell death, while largely preventing MPXV-induced transcriptomic reprogramming in macrophages. These effects were consistent across clade IIb, Ia, and Ib strains associated with the 2022–2023 global and recent African outbreaks. Together, our findings provide insight into MPXV immunopathology and support multitarget therapeutic strategies for severe mpox.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand the immunopathological manifestations of severe mpox virus (MPXV) infection, addressing the need for effective therapeutic strategies. The research sought to identify mechanisms of MPXV-induced inflammation and cell death in macrophages, which are critical for developing multitarget therapies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved a clinical cohort of mpox patients and autopsied skin tissues from a mpox patient. The design included sampling of human macrophages and skin tissues to investigate MPXV infection and its effects on inflammation and cell death.
analysis.methods: Human macrophages were infected with MPXV to study viral entry, replication, and production of infectious particles. Inflammasome activation and cell death were assessed using specific assays. Anti-inflammatory drugs were screened for their effects on MPXV-induced inflammation and cell death, and their combined efficacy with antiviral brincidofovir was evaluated.
analysis.main_results: MPXV infection in human macrophages activated AIM2 and NLRP3 inflammasomes, leading to inflammatory responses and three forms of programmed cell death: pyroptosis, apoptosis, and necroptosis. Inflammasome inhibition reduced MPXV-induced inflammation and cell death without affecting viral replication. Flufenamic acid, a clinically used anti-inflammatory drug, suppressed MPXV-induced inflammation and cell death and unexpectedly inhibited viral infection. Combined treatment with flufenamic acid and brincidofovir further enhanced suppression of viral infection, inflammatory response, and cell death.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study interpreted that inflammasome inhibition and the use of flufenamic acid as a multitarget therapeutic strategy could effectively manage mpox infection and its immunopathological effects. The novelty lies in the identification of flufenamic acid as a potential therapeutic agent that targets both inflammation and viral infection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insight into mpox immunopathology and support the development of multitarget therapeutic strategies. This could lead to more effective treatments for severe mpox cases, reducing inflammation and cell death while preventing viral reprogramming in macrophages.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the use of a small patient cohort and the need for further validation in larger clinical trials. The evidence strength is moderate due to the reliance on clinical evidence and in vitro studies, but the findings are promising for developing targeted therapies.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the mechanisms of mpox virus (MPXV) infection in macrophages, identifying inflammasome activation and cell death. It demonstrated that inflammasome inhibition and the use of flufenamic acid as a multitarget therapeutic strategy could effectively manage MPXV-induced inflammation and cell death, with promising implications for developing targeted treatments.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解严重猴痘病毒(MPXV)感染的免疫病理表现,以应对有效治疗策略的需求。研究旨在识别MPXV诱导巨噬细胞炎症和细胞死亡的机制,这对于开发多靶点疗法至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及猴痘患者的临床队列研究以及来自猴痘患者的尸检皮肤组织。研究设计包括采集人类巨噬细胞和皮肤组织样本,以研究MPXV感染及其对炎症和细胞死亡的影响。
elements_zh.methods: 人类巨噬细胞被MPXV感染以研究病毒进入、复制和产生感染性颗粒。通过特定实验评估炎性小体激活和细胞死亡。筛选抗炎药物对MPXV诱导的炎症和细胞死亡的影响,并评估其与抗病毒药物溴辛多福韦的联合疗效。
elements_zh.main_results: MPXV感染人类巨噬细胞激活AIM2和NLRP3炎性小体,导致炎症反应和三种形式的程序性细胞死亡:焦亡、凋亡和坏死。炎性小体抑制可减少MPXV诱导的炎症和细胞死亡,而不影响病毒复制。氟芬那酸是一种临床使用的抗炎药物,可抑制MPXV诱导的炎症和细胞死亡,并意外地也抑制了病毒感染。将治疗与氟芬那酸和溴辛多福韦联合使用,进一步增强了对病毒感染、炎症反应和细胞死亡的抑制作用。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究解释认为,炎性小体抑制和使用氟芬那酸作为多靶点治疗策略可以有效管理猴痘感染及其免疫病理效应。其新颖之处在于识别氟芬那酸作为可能的治疗药物,其可同时靶向炎症和病毒感染。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为猴痘免疫病理提供了见解,并支持多靶点治疗策略的开发。这可能为严重猴痘病例提供更有效的治疗,减少炎症和细胞死亡,同时防止病毒在巨噬细胞中的转录组重编程。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括患者队列研究样本量较小,需要在更大规模的临床试验中进一步验证。由于依赖临床证据和体外研究,证据强度中等,但研究结果对开发靶向治疗药物具有前景。

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study involved a clinical cohort of mpox patients and autopsied skin tissues from a mpox patient. The design included sampling of human macrophages and skin tissues to investigate MPXV infection and its effects on inflammation and cell death.
analysis_en.methods: Human macrophages were infected with MPXV to study viral entry, replication, and production of infectious particles. Inflammasome activation and cell death were assessed using specific assays. Anti-inflammatory drugs were screened for their effects on MPXV-induced inflammation and cell death, and their combined efficacy with antiviral brincidofovir was evaluated.
analysis_en.main_results: MPXV infection in human macrophages activated AIM2 and NLRP3 inflammasomes, leading to inflammatory responses and three forms of programmed cell death: pyroptosis, apoptosis, and necroptosis. Inflammasome inhibition reduced MPXV-induced inflammation and cell death without affecting viral replication. Flufenamic acid, a clinically used anti-inflammatory drug, suppressed MPXV-induced inflammation and cell death and unexpectedly inhibited viral infection. Combined treatment with flufenamic acid and brincidofovir further enhanced suppression of viral infection, inflammatory response, and cell death.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study interpreted that inflammasome inhibition and the use of flufenamic acid as a multitarget therapeutic strategy could effectively manage mpox infection and its immunopathological effects. The novelty lies in the identification of flufenamic acid as a potential therapeutic agent that targets both inflammation and viral infection.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insight into mpox immunopathology and support the development of multitarget therapeutic strategies. This could lead to more effective treatments for severe mpox cases, reducing inflammation and cell death while preventing viral reprogramming in macrophages.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the use of a small patient cohort and the need for further validation in larger clinical trials. The evidence strength is moderate due to the reliance on clinical evidence and in vitro studies, but the findings are promising for developing targeted therapies.

title_zh: 猴痘病毒感染巨噬细胞激活炎性小体和细胞死亡,为多靶点治疗策略提供信息
source_body_en: Severe mpox virus (MPXV) infection causes immunopathological manifestations in patients. Here, we provide clinical evidence of MPXV-induced inflammation in a large patient cohort and demonstrate direct macrophage infection in skin tissues from an autopsied mpox patient. In human macrophages, MPXV efficiently enters, replicates, and produces infectious particles. Infection activates both AIM2 and NLRP3 inflammasomes, triggering inflammatory responses and three forms of programmed cell death: pyroptosis, apoptosis, and necroptosis. Inflammasome inhibition reduces MPXV-induced inflammation and cell death without affecting viral replication. Screening clinically used anti-inflammatory drugs identified flufenamic acid, which suppresses MPXV-induced inflammation and cell death and, unexpectedly, also inhibits viral infection. Combined treatment with flufenamic acid and the antiviral brincidofovir further enhances suppression of viral infection, inflammatory response, and cell death, while largely preventing MPXV-induced transcriptomic reprogramming in macrophages. These effects were consistent across clade IIb, Ia, and Ib strains associated with the 2022–2023 global and recent African outbreaks. Together, our findings provide insight into MPXV immunopathology and support multitarget therapeutic strategies for severe mpox.
abstract_zh: 严重的猴痘病毒(MPXV)感染会导致患者出现免疫病理表现。在此,我们提供了大量猴痘患者的MPXV诱导炎症的临床证据,并展示了来自猴痘患者尸检皮肤组织中的直接巨噬细胞感染。在人类巨噬细胞中,MPXV高效进入、复制并产生感染性颗粒。感染激活了AIM2和NLRP3炎性小体,引发炎症反应和三种形式的程序性细胞死亡:焦亡、凋亡和坏死。炎性小体抑制可减少MPXV诱导的炎症和细胞死亡,而不影响病毒复制。筛选临床使用的抗炎药物,发现氟芬那酸可抑制MPXV诱导的炎症和细胞死亡,并意外地也抑制了病毒感染。将治疗与氟芬那酸和抗病毒药物溴辛多福韦联合使用,进一步增强了对病毒感染、炎症反应和细胞死亡的抑制作用,同时在很大程度上防止了MPXV对巨噬细胞的转录组重编程。这些效果在与2022–2023年全球及近期非洲暴发相关的IIb、Ia和Ib菌株中均一致。综上,我们的研究结果为MPXV免疫病理提供了见解,并支持针对严重猴痘的多靶点治疗策略。
summary_zh: 严重的猴痘病毒(MPXV)感染会导致患者出现免疫病理表现。在此,我们提供了大量猴痘患者的MPXV诱导炎症的临床证据,并展示了来自猴痘患者尸检皮肤组织中的直接巨噬细胞感染。在人类巨噬细胞中,MPXV高效进入、复制并产生感染性颗粒。感染激活了AIM2和NLRP3炎性小体,引发炎症反应和三种形式的程序性细胞死亡:焦亡、凋亡和坏死。炎性小体抑制可减少MPXV诱导的炎症和细胞死亡,而不影响病毒复制。筛选临床使用的抗炎药物,发现氟芬那酸可抑制MPXV诱导的炎症和细胞死亡,并意外地也抑制了病毒感染。将治疗与氟芬那酸和抗病毒药物溴辛多福韦联合使用,进一步增强了对病毒感染、炎症反应和细胞死亡的抑制作用,同时在很大程度上防止了MPXV对巨噬细胞的转录组重编程。这些效果在与2022–2023年全球及近期非洲暴发相关的IIb、Ia和Ib菌株中均一致。综上,我们的研究结果为MPXV免疫病理提供了见解,并支持针对严重猴痘的多靶点治疗策略。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解严重猴痘病毒(MPXV)感染的免疫病理表现,以应对有效治疗策略的需求。研究旨在识别MPXV诱导巨噬细胞炎症和细胞死亡的机制,这对于开发多靶点疗法至关重要。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及猴痘患者的临床队列研究以及来自猴痘患者的尸检皮肤组织。研究设计包括采集人类巨噬细胞和皮肤组织样本,以研究MPXV感染及其对炎症和细胞死亡的影响。
analysis_zh.methods: 人类巨噬细胞被MPXV感染以研究病毒进入、复制和产生感染性颗粒。通过特定实验评估炎性小体激活和细胞死亡。筛选抗炎药物对MPXV诱导的炎症和细胞死亡的影响,并评估其与抗病毒药物溴辛多福韦的联合疗效。
analysis_zh.main_results: MPXV感染人类巨噬细胞激活AIM2和NLRP3炎性小体,导致炎症反应和三种形式的程序性细胞死亡:焦亡、凋亡和坏死。炎性小体抑制可减少MPXV诱导的炎症和细胞死亡,而不影响病毒复制。氟芬那酸是一种临床使用的抗炎药物,可抑制MPXV诱导的炎症和细胞死亡,并意外地也抑制了病毒感染。将治疗与氟芬那酸和溴辛多福韦联合使用,进一步增强了对病毒感染、炎症反应和细胞死亡的抑制作用。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究解释认为,炎性小体抑制和使用氟芬那酸作为多靶点治疗策略可以有效管理猴痘感染及其免疫病理效应。其新颖之处在于识别氟芬那酸作为可能的治疗药物,其可同时靶向炎症和病毒感染。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为猴痘免疫病理提供了见解,并支持多靶点治疗策略的开发。这可能为严重猴痘病例提供更有效的治疗,减少炎症和细胞死亡,同时防止病毒在巨噬细胞中的转录组重编程。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括患者队列研究样本量较小,需要在更大规模的临床试验中进一步验证。由于依赖临床证据和体外研究,证据强度中等,但研究结果对开发靶向治疗药物具有前景。

title: Hairpin Architecture and Extended Sequence Context Shape APOBEC3 Mutagenesis in Monkeypox Virus at Different Genomic Scales
abstract: Abstract The 2022 global mpox outbreak was characterized by an unusual accumulation of more than fifty APOBEC-signature substitutions in MPXV genomes. A previous study suggested that these substitutions preferentially occur within and near hairpins or cruciforms – stem-loop structures formed by inverted repeats. Here, we show that this conclusion resulted from an inappropriate statistical analysis and, using two substantially larger datasets, demonstrate that APOBEC-signature mutations are specifically enriched at TC motifs located at the 3′ ends of hairpin loops, but not in other regions of hairpins/cruciforms or in their vicinity. We further identified a preference for stem-loop structures with longer stems and shorter loops, consistent with patterns previously reported for the APOBEC mutagenesis in cancer genomes. Our analysis also revealed a positive association between APOBEC-signature mutation propensity and hairpin stability in single-stranded DNA. Nevertheless, stem-loop structures with long stems and short loops are relatively rare in the MPXV genome, limiting their contribution to the genome-wide distribution of APOBEC-signature mutations to a predominantly local effect. In contrast, extended nucleotide context downstream of the TC motif showed strong genome-wide predictive value, with a marked preference for guanine-rich trinucleotide immediately downstream. Analysis of the upstream nucleotide context was consistent with the mutational specificity of APOBEC3A. Together, these results identify distinct structural and sequence determinants of the APOBEC-associated mutagenesis in MPXV and show that local hairpin/cruciform architecture and extended nucleotide context contribute at different genomic scales.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the mutagenic effects of APOBEC3 on the Mpox virus genome, addressing the need to understand the unusual accumulation of APOBEC-signature substitutions observed during the 2022 global mpox outbreak.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed two substantially larger datasets of MPXV genomes to reassess the previously reported association between APOBEC-signature mutations and hairpin/cruciform structures, focusing on the genomic scales and contexts where these mutations occur.
analysis.methods: The researchers conducted a statistical reanalysis of MPXV genomic data, identifying TC motifs at the 3′ ends of hairpin loops and examining the relationship between APOBEC-signature mutation propensity and stem-loop structures with specific lengths, as well as extended nucleotide contexts downstream of these motifs.
analysis.main_results: The study found that APOBEC-signature mutations are specifically enriched at TC motifs located at the 3′ ends of hairpin loops, and there is a positive association between mutation propensity and hairpin stability in single-stranded DNA. Additionally, extended nucleotide context downstream of the TC motif showed strong genome-wide predictive value.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted their findings as revealing distinct structural and sequence determinants of APOBEC-associated mutagenesis in MPXV, highlighting the importance of local hairpin/cruciform architecture and extended nucleotide context at different genomic scales.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings contribute to understanding the mechanisms of APOBEC3 mutagenesis in MPXV, which may inform surveillance, diagnosis, and future research on viral evolution and host-virus interactions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study notes that stem-loop structures with long stems and short loops are relatively rare in the MPXV genome, which limits their contribution to genome-wide mutation patterns. The evidence is based on two substantially larger datasets, providing a moderate level of confidence.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the mutagenic effects of APOBEC3 on the Mpox virus genome, addressing the unusual accumulation of APOBEC-signature substitutions observed during the 2022 global mpox outbreak. The researchers reanalyzed two larger datasets of MPXV genomes and found that APOBEC-signature mutations are specifically enriched at TC motifs located at the 3′ ends of hairpin loops, rather than in other regions of hairpins or cruciforms. They also identified a positive association between mutation propensity and hairpin stability in single-stranded DNA, as well as a strong genome-wide predictive value of extended nucleotide context downstream of the TC motif. These results highlight distinct structural and sequence determinants of APOBEC-associated mutagenesis in MPXV, with implications for understanding viral evolution and host-virus interactions. However, the study notes that stem-loop structures with long stems and short loops are relatively rare in the MPXV genome, limiting their contribution to genome-wide mutation patterns. The evidence is based on two substantially larger datasets, providing a moderate level of confidence.

abstract_zh: 摘要 2022年全球猴痘 暴发疫情中观察到猴痘病毒(MPXV)基因组中出现了超过五十个APOBEC特征性替换。此前的一项研究认为这些替换主要发生在发夹结构或十字形结构(由反向重复序列形成)内部及附近。然而,我们发现这一结论源于不恰当的统计分析,并通过两个规模显著更大的数据集证明,APOBEC特征性突变在发夹结构环的3′端TC基序处特异性富集,而非发夹结构/十字形结构的其他区域或其邻近区域。我们进一步发现,对于具有更长茎和更短环的发夹结构存在偏好,这与之前在癌症中报道的APOBEC突变模式一致。我们的分析还揭示了APOBEC特征性突变倾向与单链DNA中发夹结构稳定性之间存在正相关。然而,MPXV基因组中具有长茎和短环的发夹结构相对较少,因此它们对整个基因组中APOBEC特征性突变分布的贡献主要局限于局部效应。相比之下,TC基序下游的扩展核苷酸背景表现出强烈的全基因组预测价值,且对下游的富含鸟嘌呤的三核苷酸有显著偏好。对上游核苷酸背景的分析与APOBEC3A的突变特异性一致。综上所述,这些结果揭示了MPXV中与APOBEC相关的突变的结构和序列决定因素,并表明局部发夹/十字形结构和扩展核苷酸背景在不同基因组尺度上分别发挥贡献。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨APOBEC3对猴痘病毒 基因组的突变效应,以解决对2022年全球猴痘 暴发期间观察到的APOBEC特征性替换异常积累的理解需求。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了两个规模显著更大的MPXV 基因组数据集,以重新评估之前报道的APOBEC特征性突变与发夹/十字形结构之间的关联,重点关注这些突变在基因组尺度和背景中的分布情况。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员对MPXV基因组数据进行了统计重新分析,确定了发夹结构环3′端的TC基序,并研究了APOBEC特征性突变倾向与特定长度的发夹结构以及这些基序下游的扩展核苷酸背景之间的关系。
analysis_zh.main_results: 研究发现,APOBEC特征性突变在发夹结构环3′端的TC基序处特异性富集,且在单链DNA中,突变倾向与发夹结构稳定性呈正相关。此外,TC基序下游的扩展核苷酸背景表现出强烈的全基因组预测价值。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将他们的发现解释为揭示了MPXV中与APOBEC相关的突变的结构和序列决定因素,强调了局部发夹/十字形结构和扩展核苷酸背景在不同基因组尺度上的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现有助于理解MPXV中APOBEC3突变的机制,可能为监测、诊断以及未来关于病毒进化和宿主-病毒相互作用的研究提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 研究指出,MPXV基因组中具有长茎和短环的发夹结构相对较少,这限制了它们对全基因组APOBEC特征性突变模式的贡献。研究证据基于两个规模显著更大的数据集,提供了中等程度的置信度。

title: Predictors of Mpox Knowledge Among Residents of Akwa Ibom State Nigeria
abstract: Abstract Background Mpox remains a significant public health threat in Nigeria and a re-emerging zoonotic disease. Adequate public knowledge and effective risk communication are essential for prevention and control, yet knowledge levels and influencing factors vary across populations. This study assessed the relationship between socio-demographic characteristics, preferred information channels, and Mpox knowledge among residents of Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria, to inform targeted health communication strategies. Methods A cross-sectional study was conducted among 475 adult residents of Akwa-Ibom State, aged 18 years and above. A random sampling technique was used to recruit participants across local government areas. Data were collected using a structured, pretested questionnaire, administered electronically via Kobo Collect. The primary outcome was knowledge of Mpox. Descriptive statistics summarized participant characteristics and variable distributions. Multivariable binary logistic regression analysis identified independent predictors of Mpox knowledge, with results presented as adjusted odds ratios at 95% confidence intervals. Statistical significance was set at p Results Of the 475 participants, females constituted 62.6% of the sample, with 62.8% being married and 48.2% employed as civil servants. Age (adjusted OR 1.54, 95% CI: 1.20–1.97) and being married (adjusted OR 2.00, 95% CI: 1.31–3.06) were significant demographic predictors. Among those aware of Mpox, 80.8% correctly identified skin rash and swollen lymph nodes as key symptoms; 69.1% reported knowledge of Mpox. Preference in traditional sources showed a negative association. Gender and occupation were not significant predictors. Conclusions Mpox knowledge in the study population is moderate, with clear disparities influenced by demographic factors and information sources. Strengthening integrated risk communication strategies that leverage healthcare workers, digital platforms, and traditional media is essential for improving public knowledge and outbreak preparedness.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究评估了阿夸伊博姆州居民的社会人口学特征、偏好的信息渠道与猴痘知识之间的关系,以制定有针对性的健康沟通策略。在尼日利亚阿夸伊博姆州475名18岁及以上的成年人中进行了横断面研究。数据通过Kobo Collect平台上的结构化、预测试问卷进行电子收集。

Among those aware of Mpox, 80.8% correctly identified skin rash and swollen lymph nodes as key symptoms; 69.1% reported knowledge of Mpox.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究人群中猴痘的知识水平中等,存在明显的差异,这些差异受到人口学因素和信息来源的影响。传统信息来源的偏好显示出负相关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 加强整合风险沟通策略,利用医疗工作者、数字平台和传统媒体,对于提高公众知识和暴发的应对能力至关重要。这些发现可以为制定有针对性的健康沟通策略,以解决猴痘知识差异提供依据。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告局限性。本研究基于自我报告数据,未考虑潜在的偏倚或混杂因素。由于采用横断面设计并依赖调查数据,证据强度中等。

title: Knowledge, attitudes, perceptions and factors associated with mpox vaccine hesitancy among university students in Sierra Leone: a cross-sectional study
abstract: Abstract Background Mpox remains a public health concern, particularly in settings where access to reliable health information, vaccination and health services may be limited. University students are an important population for mpox prevention because of their social interactions and potential influence on health behaviours. This study assessed knowledge, attitudes and perceptions of mpox and examined factors associated with reported mpox vaccine hesitancy among students in Sierra Leone. Methods A cross-sectional study was conducted among 422 students from three constituent colleges of the University of Sierra Leone between January and June 2026. Data were collected using a structured questionnaire assessing knowledge, attitudes, perceptions and vaccination intention. Vaccine hesitancy was defined as reporting that the participant would not take an mpox vaccine if it were available. Univariable and multivariable binary logistic regression were performed to identify factors associated with reported hesitancy, with crude and adjusted odds ratios (CORs and AORs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) reported. Results Of 422 participants, 287 (68.0%) reported willingness to receive an mpox vaccine, while 135 (32.0%) were classified as hesitant. Good knowledge was observed in 332 (78.7%) participants, while 174 (41.2%) had a positive attitude and 249 (59.0%) had a positive perception. analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study investigated mpox vaccine hesitancy among university students in Sierra Leone, focusing on knowledge, attitudes, and perceptions. Conducted between January and June 2026, the study involved 422 participants from three constituent colleges of the University of Sierra Leone. Results showed that 68.0% of participants were willing to receive the mpox vaccine, while 32.0% were hesitant. Good knowledge was reported by 78.7% of participants, with positive attitudes and perceptions observed in 41.2% and 59.0%, respectively. The study identified factors associated with vaccine hesitancy, emphasizing the importance of understanding social and psychological influences in this population. The findings suggest potential strategies for improving mpox prevention efforts. However, the study's cross-sectional design limits its ability to establish causality, and the evidence is considered moderate due to reliance on self-reported data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 猴痘仍然是一个公共卫生问题,特别是在获取可靠健康信息、疫苗接种和医疗服务可能受限的环境中。由于大学生的社会互动及其对健康行为的潜在影响,他们是猴痘预防的重要人群。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2026年1月至6月期间,在塞拉利昂大学的三个下属学院中对422名学生进行了横断面研究。本研究评估了大学生对猴痘的知识、态度和认知,并探讨了报告中猴痘 疫苗犹豫的相关因素。
elements_zh.methods: 使用结构化问卷收集数据,评估知识、态度、认知和疫苗接种意图。通过单变量和多变量二元逻辑回归分析确定与报告中犹豫相关的因素,并报告了粗略和调整后的比值比(CORs和AORs)以及95%置信区间(CIs)。
elements_zh.main_results: 在422名参与者中,287名(68.0%)表示愿意接种猴痘 疫苗,而135名(32.0%)被归类为犹豫。332名(78.7%)参与者表现出良好的知识水平,174名(41.2%)具有积极态度,249名(59.0%)具有积极认知。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究突出了塞拉利昂大学生中猴痘 疫苗犹豫的相关因素,为了解该人群对疫苗接受的社会和心理决定因素提供了见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为针对大学生疫苗犹豫的公共卫生干预措施提供信息,可能有助于改善塞拉利昂的猴痘预防策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其横断面设计,无法确定因果关系。证据强度中等,因为它基于自我报告数据,且不包括纵向或实验性成分。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 2026年1月至6月期间,在塞拉利昂大学的三个下属学院中对422名学生进行了横断面研究。本研究评估了大学生对猴痘的知识、态度和认知,并探讨了报告中猴痘 疫苗犹豫的相关因素。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用结构化问卷收集数据,评估知识、态度、认知和疫苗接种意图。通过单变量和多变量二元逻辑回归分析确定与报告中犹豫相关的因素,并报告了粗略和调整后的比值比(CORs和AORs)以及95%置信区间(CIs)。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为针对大学生疫苗犹豫的公共卫生干预措施提供信息,可能有助于改善塞拉利昂的猴痘预防策略。

title: Monkeypox virus M2 rewires nucleocytoplasmic transport to coordinate host translation suppression and immune evasion
abstract: Abstract Host shutoff is a conserved viral strategy to dismantle cellular defenses, yet the molecular orchestrators in large DNA viruses remain poorly defined. Through a systematic functional screen of the monkeypox virus (MPXV) proteome, we identify M2 as a potent, multifunctional effector that executes a global blockade of host gene expression. Unlike its assembly-centric homologs across the orthopoxvirus genus, M2 localizes not only to the well-characterized endoplasmic reticulum but also to the nuclear envelope, where it may function as a molecular chokepoint, obstructing bidirectional nucleocytoplasmic transport. Concurrently, M2 expression is also associated with altered Akt/mTOR/4EBP1 signaling axis, which may contribute to reduced cap-dependent translation. Intriguingly, M2 may induce a ‘transcriptional trap’ — triggering a robust but futile ERK-dependent activation of AP-1-mediated stress responses that are decoupled from translation. Using recombinant virus engineering, we provide evidence that M2 expression augments viral replication in cell culture. These findings suggest that M2 may contribute to MPXV-mediated host shutoff, although further studies under authentic infection conditions are required to establish causality and define the underlying mechanism. Our study preliminarily reveals an paradigm for viral niche adaptation, in which a single protein coordinates spatial sequestration and biochemical suppression to enact multi-layered host suppression, providing critical candidate targets for therapeutic intervention against emerging orthopoxviruses.

title_zh: 猴痘病毒M2通过重新编程核质运输协调宿主翻译抑制和免疫逃逸
source_body_en: Abstract Host shutoff is a conserved viral strategy to dismantle cellular defenses, yet the molecular orchestrators in large DNA viruses remain poorly defined. Through a systematic functional screen of the monkeypox virus (MPXV) proteome, we identify M2 as a potent, multifunctional effector that executes a global blockade of host gene expression. Unlike its assembly-centric homologs across the orthopoxvirus genus, M2 localizes not only to the well-characterized endoplasmic reticulum but also to the nuclear envelope, where it may function as a molecular chokepoint, obstructing bidirectional nucleocytoplasmic transport. Concurrently, M2 expression is also associated with altered Akt/mTOR/4EBP1 signaling axis, which may contribute to reduced cap-dependent translation. Intriguingly, M2 may induce a ‘transcriptional trap’ — triggering a robust but futile ERK-dependent activation of AP-1-mediated stress responses that are decoupled from translation. Using recombinant virus engineering, we provide evidence that M2 expression augments viral replication in cell culture. These findings suggest that M2 may contribute to MPXV-mediated host shutoff, although further studies under authentic infection conditions are required to establish causality and define the underlying mechanism. Our study preliminarily reveals an paradigm for viral niche adaptation, in which a single protein coordinates spatial sequestration and biochemical suppression to enact multi-layered host suppression, providing critical candidate targets for therapeutic intervention against emerging orthopoxviruses.
abstract_zh: 摘要 宿主抑制是一种保守的病毒策略,用于破坏细胞防御,但大型DNA病毒中该过程的分子协调者仍不明确。通过系统性功能筛选猴痘病毒(MPXV)的蛋白质组,我们发现M2是一种强效且多功能的效应因子,能够全局性地阻断宿主基因表达。与正痘病毒属中以组装为中心的同源蛋白不同,M2不仅定位于已知的内质网,还定位于核膜,可能作为分子瓶颈,阻碍双向核质运输。同时,M2的表达还与Akt/mTOR/4EBP1信号轴的改变相关,这可能有助于减少帽依赖性翻译。有趣的是,M2可能诱导一种‘转录陷阱’——触发由ERK依赖的强而无效的AP-1介导的应激反应,这些反应与翻译脱钩。通过重组病毒工程,我们提供了证据表明M2的表达可增强病毒在细胞培养中的复制。这些发现表明M2可能参与MPXV介导的宿主抑制,尽管需要在真实感染条件下进一步研究以确定因果关系和定义其潜在机制。我们的研究初步揭示了一种病毒生态位适应的范式,其中单个蛋白通过空间隔离和生化抑制的协调作用,实现多层宿主抑制,为针对新兴正痘病毒的治疗干预提供了关键候选靶点。

title: Informing an mpox stockpile investment case: epidemiological modelling and cost-benefit analysis.
abstract: BACKGROUND: In response to ongoing mpox outbreaks, Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance, was considering funding the establishment of an mpox vaccine stockpile. To support their decision making, Gavi commissioned the Center for Outbreak Response Innovation at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health to estimate the optimal size, impact, health benefits, and monetised net benefits of different mpox vaccine stockpile sizes for an effective global stockpile to support outbreak containment and prevention of widespread mpox transmission. We aimed to quantify the potential impact of vaccination on future mpox outbreaks to inform Gavi's decision making for investing in an effective mpox vaccine stockpile. METHODS: A deterministic compartmental model of mpox transmission with vaccine interventions was developed, including intervening rapidly-at 20 cases reported-versus at 100 cases reported. The model was used to assess potential vaccine-based mitigation strategies for mpox outbreaks in Gavi-eligible countries by simulating mpox transmission and control dynamics, given two vaccination strategies (one dose and two doses) compared with no intervention in high-risk groups and contacts of cases, across four distinct subpopulations: (1) children younger than 5 years, (2) men who have sex with men, (3) female sex workers, and (4) the remaining general population. The findings from this model were incorporated into a Monte Carlo cost-benefit analysis of different stockpile sizes. FINDINGS: Rapid response (ie, intervening at 20 cases reported) using a single-dose vaccination strategy provided the greatest benefits relative to costs compared with a two-dose strategy. Using a one-dose strategy, expected net benefits were estimated to be over US$81 million to $220 million higher when responding to outbreaks rapidly than when responding after 100 cases. Furthermore, the total cost per disability-adjusted life-year (DALY) averted with rapid response using a one-dose vaccine strategy responding at 20 cases was 18% to 53% lower than a one-dose strategy introduced at 100 cases. A stockpile of 1 000 000 doses had the highest ratio of benefits to costs. INTERPRETATION: A stockpile calibrated to attain a high ratio of benefits to costs can be effective in controlling outbreaks and reducing overall negative health impacts. The cost-effectiveness of mpox vaccine stockpiles could be further maximised with reduced vaccine pricing and dose-sparing strategies. FUNDING: Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance.

analysis.research_question_and_background: To support Gavi's decision making for investing in an mpox vaccine stockpile, the study aimed to quantify the potential impact of vaccination on future mpox outbreaks.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used a deterministic compartmental model to simulate mpox transmission and control dynamics in four subpopulations across Gavi-eligible countries, with two vaccination strategies (one dose and two doses) compared to no intervention.
analysis.methods: A deterministic compartmental model was developed to assess potential vaccine-based mitigation strategies for mpox outbreaks, incorporating two vaccination strategies and simulating across four subpopulations.
analysis.main_results: Rapid response using a one-dose vaccination strategy provided the greatest benefits relative to costs compared with a two-dose strategy, with expected net benefits estimated to be over US$81 million to $220 million higher when responding to outbreaks rapidly than when responding after 100 cases.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that a stockpile calibrated to attain a high ratio of benefits to costs can be effective in controlling outbreaks and reducing overall negative health impacts, and that the cost-effectiveness of mpox vaccine stockpiles could be further maximised with reduced vaccine pricing and dose-sparing strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study's findings can inform Gavi's decision making for investing in an effective mpox vaccine stockpile, supporting outbreak containment and prevention of widespread mpox transmission.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the use of a deterministic model, which may not capture all aspects of mpox transmission dynamics, and the reliance on Monte Carlo cost-benefit analysis, which may introduce uncertainty.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 为支持Gavi在投资猴痘 疫苗储备方面的决策,本研究旨在量化疫苗接种对未来猴痘 暴发的潜在影响。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用确定性分室模型,模拟在Gavi资格国家的四个亚人群中(1)5岁以下儿童,(2)男男性行为者,(3)女性性工作者,(4)其余一般人群)的猴痘 传播及其控制动态,比较两种疫苗接种策略(单剂量和双剂量)与无干预措施。
elements_zh.methods: 开发了一个确定性分室模型,用于评估针对猴痘 暴发的潜在基于疫苗的缓解策略,纳入了两种疫苗接种策略,并模拟了四个亚人群中的动态。
elements_zh.main_results: Rapid response using a one-dose vaccination strategy provided the greatest benefits relative to costs compared with a two-dose strategy, with expected net benefits estimated to be over US$81 million to $220 million higher when responding to outbreaks rapidly than when responding after 100 cases.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,一个能够实现高效益与成本比率的储备在控制暴发和减少整体负面健康影响方面可能是有效的,同时通过降低疫苗的价格和采用剂量节约策略,可以进一步提高猴痘 疫苗储备的成本效益。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 本研究的结果可以为Gavi在投资有效猴痘 疫苗储备方面的决策提供信息,支持暴发的控制和预防广泛传播的猴痘 传播。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括使用了确定性模型,可能无法全面捕捉猴痘 传播的动态,以及依赖蒙特卡洛成本效益分析,这可能引入不确定性。

title: Prolonged Recurrent Unilateral Keratitis Following Mpox: Clinical Course and Diagnostic Challenges
abstract: A 22-year-old man with a recorded history of mpox presented with right-eye pain and reduced vision of approximately one month's duration. Clinical notes, anterior segment photographs, and two in vivo confocal microscopy reports were reviewed. Mpox should be considered in the differential diagnosis of prolonged or recurrent unilateral keratitis in patients with a documented history of infection, particularly when the clinical course is atypical or fluctuating. This case highlights the potential for delayed ocular involvement and the importance of careful clinical assessment for keratitis with a history of mpox.
journal: Journal of the Foundations of Ophthalmology

title: Severe Mpox in People with Advanced HIV Disease and LF-LAM-Positive Tuberculosis: A Report of Three Cases from Nigeria
abstract: Mpox can cause severe and fatal disease in people with advanced human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) disease, particularly when complicated by other infections. We report three hospitalized patients with advanced HIV disease, severe mpox, and tuberculosis diagnosed by positive urine lateral-flow lipoarabinomannan (LF-LAM) testing in Nigeria. A 44-year-old man with newly diagnosed HIV presented with extensive necrotizing cutaneous mpox, clinically suspected sepsis, and Staphylococcus aureus bacteraemia and died before antiretroviral therapy (ART) or tuberculosis treatment could be initiated. A 22-year-old woman with perinatally acquired HIV was receiving regular ART and had an HIV ribonucleic acid (RNA) level below 30 copies/mL. She developed severe nodulopustular mpox with genital involvement and improved following tuberculosis treatment while ART was continued. A 28-year-old woman who had interrupted ART for more than one year developed widespread mpox and deteriorated seven days after ART reinitiation, raising concern for suspected unmasking immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS). All three patients had positive urine LF-LAM results and PCR-confirmed mpox from vesiculopustular lesions and/or crusts. Molecular tuberculosis (TB) testing was not performed, and no culture or imaging was available to establish the anatomical extent of TB. These cases highlight the diagnostic complexity of severe mpox in advanced HIV disease and the importance of evaluating for concurrent opportunistic and bacterial infections.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to highlight the clinical complexity of mpox in individuals with advanced HIV disease and concurrent tuberculosis, emphasizing the need for awareness of severe mpox outcomes in immunocompromised populations.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This report describes three hospitalized cases in Nigeria involving patients with advanced HIV disease, severe mpox, and tuberculosis diagnosed by positive urine LF-LAM testing.
analysis.methods: Mpox was confirmed by PCR from vesiculopustular lesions and/or crusts, and all patients had positive urine LF-LAM results for tuberculosis. Molecular TB testing was not performed, and no culture or imaging was available to determine the anatomical extent of TB.
analysis.main_results: A 44-year-old man with newly diagnosed HIV presented with extensive necrotizing cutaneous mpox, clinically suspected sepsis, and Staphylococcus aureus bacteraemia and died before ART or TB treatment could be initiated. A 22-year-old woman with perinatally acquired HIV and undetectable HIV RNA developed severe nodulopustular mpox with genital involvement. A 28-year-old woman who had interrupted ART for over a year developed widespread mpox and deteriorated seven days after ART reinitiation.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The cases suggest that severe mpox can occur in individuals with advanced HIV disease, especially when complicated by other infections, and that immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS) may be a concern upon resuming ART.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These cases underscore the importance of considering concurrent opportunistic and bacterial infections in the diagnosis and management of severe mpox in patients with advanced HIV disease, informing clinical practices and surveillance strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to case reports, and molecular TB testing was not performed, which may affect the certainty of TB diagnosis. The evidence is moderate due to the observational nature of the study.

analysis.summary_en: This report presents three cases of severe mpox in patients with advanced HIV disease and tuberculosis in Nigeria. The first case involved a man with newly diagnosed HIV who died before treatment, highlighting the severity of mpox in immunocompromised individuals. The second case was a woman on ART with undetectable HIV RNA who developed severe mpox with genital involvement and improved with TB treatment. The third case was a woman who had interrupted ART and developed widespread mpox, deteriorating after ART reinitiation, raising concerns about immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS). These cases emphasize the diagnostic challenges and clinical complexity of mpox in patients with advanced HIV and concurrent infections, underscoring the need for vigilant monitoring and integrated management strategies. The study is limited to case reports, and the absence of molecular TB testing may affect the certainty of TB diagnosis, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在突出猴痘在晚期HIV疾病和并发结核病患者中的临床复杂性,强调在免疫功能低下人群中对严重猴痘结果的认识的重要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本报告描述了尼日利亚三例住院病例,涉及晚期HIV疾病、严重猴痘和通过尿液LF-LAM阳性检测确诊的结核病患者。
elements_zh.methods: 猴痘通过来自水疱性脓疱性病变和/或结痂的PCR检测得到确认,所有患者均具有尿液LF-LAM阳性结果以诊断结核病。未进行分子结核病(TB)检测,也无培养或影像学检查可用于确定TB的解剖范围。
elements_zh.main_results: 一名44岁男性刚被诊断为HIV,出现了广泛的坏死性皮肤猴痘,临床怀疑脓毒症,并伴有金黄色葡萄球菌败血症,死于ART或结核病治疗开始之前。一名22岁女性通过产前途径获得HIV,且HIV RNA水平不可检测,出现了严重的结节性脓疱性猴痘并伴有生殖器受累。一名28岁女性在中断ART超过一年后,出现了广泛的猴痘,并在重新开始ART治疗后7天病情恶化。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些病例表明,猴痘可能在晚期HIV疾病患者中发生,尤其是在合并其他感染时,且在恢复ART治疗时可能需要警惕免疫重建炎症综合征(IRIS)。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些病例强调了在晚期HIV疾病患者中,考虑并发机会性感染和细菌感染对于猴痘的诊断和管理的重要性,为临床实践和监测策略提供了信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于病例报告,未进行分子结核病(TB)检测,这可能影响TB 诊断的确定性。由于研究的观察性质,证据强度中等。

She developed severe nodulopustular mpox with genital involvement and improved following tuberculosis treatment while ART was continued. A 28-year-old woman who had interrupted ART for more than one year developed widespread mpox and deteriorated seven days after ART reinitiation, raising concern for suspected unmasking immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS). All three patients had positive urine LF-LAM results and PCR-confirmed mpox from vesiculopustular lesions and/or crusts. Molecular tuberculosis (TB) testing was not performed, and no culture or imaging was available to establish the anatomical extent of TB. These cases highlight the diagnostic complexity of severe mpox in advanced HIV disease and the importance of evaluating for concurrent opportunistic and bacterial infections.
abstract_zh: 猴痘可在晚期人类免疫缺陷病毒(HIV)疾病患者中引起严重且致命的疾病,尤其是在合并其他感染时。我们报告了三例在尼日利亚住院的晚期HIV疾病患者,他们患有严重的猴痘和通过尿液LF-LAM检测确诊的结核病。一名44岁男性刚被诊断为HIV,出现了广泛的坏死性皮肤猴痘,临床怀疑脓毒症,并伴有金黄色葡萄球菌败血症,死于抗逆转录病毒治疗(ART)或结核病治疗开始之前。一名22岁女性通过产前途径获得HIV,正在接受常规ART治疗,其HIV核糖核酸(RNA)水平低于30拷贝/毫升。她出现了严重的结节性脓疱性猴痘,并伴有生殖器受累,但在继续ART治疗的同时,通过结核病治疗治疗后病情改善。一名28岁女性在中断ART超过一年后,出现了广泛的猴痘,并在重新开始ART治疗后7天病情恶化,引发了对疑似免疫重建炎症综合征(IRIS)的担忧。这三名患者均具有尿液LF-LAM阳性结果,并且通过PCR确认了来自水疱性脓疱性病变和/或结痂的猴痘。未进行分子结核病(TB)检测,也无培养或影像学检查可用于确定TB的解剖范围。这些病例突显了在晚期HIV疾病中严重猴痘的诊断复杂性,并强调了对并发机会性感染和细菌感染进行评估的重要性。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在突出猴痘在晚期HIV疾病和并发结核病患者中的临床复杂性,强调在免疫功能低下人群中对严重猴痘结果的认识的重要性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本报告描述了尼日利亚三例住院病例,涉及晚期HIV疾病、严重猴痘和通过尿液LF-LAM阳性检测确诊的结核病患者。
analysis_zh.methods: 猴痘通过来自水疱性脓疱性病变和/或结痂的PCR检测得到确认,所有患者均具有尿液LF-LAM阳性结果以诊断结核病。未进行分子结核病(TB)检测,也无培养或影像学检查可用于确定TB的解剖范围。
analysis_zh.main_results: 一名44岁男性刚被诊断为HIV,出现了广泛的坏死性皮肤猴痘,临床怀疑脓毒症,并伴有金黄色葡萄球菌败血症,死于ART或结核病治疗开始之前。一名22岁女性通过产前途径获得HIV,且HIV RNA水平不可检测,出现了严重的结节性脓疱性猴痘并伴有生殖器受累。一名28岁女性在中断ART超过一年后,出现了广泛的猴痘,并在重新开始ART治疗后7天病情恶化。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些病例表明,猴痘可能在晚期HIV疾病患者中发生,尤其是在合并其他感染时,且在恢复ART治疗时可能需要警惕免疫重建炎症综合征(IRIS)。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些病例强调了在晚期HIV疾病患者中,考虑并发机会性感染和细菌感染对于猴痘的诊断和管理的重要性,为临床实践和监测策略提供了信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于病例报告,未进行分子结核病(TB)检测,这可能影响TB 诊断的确定性。由于研究的观察性质,证据强度中等。

title: AI-Driven Design of Next-Generation Immunoinformatics Multi-Epitope Subunit Vaccine Targeting the Most Virulent Mpox Proteome: A Structural and Kinetic Validation Framework
abstract: The resurgence of the Mpox virus (MPXV) highlights the urgent need for scalable, mutation-resistant countermeasures. Slow development timelines hinder traditional empirical vaccine discovery, while conventional vaccinology often yields high false-positive rates because it relies on static, linear sequence-based screening. These classical informatics filters consistently fail to predict physical structural stability or the dynamic presentation of immune cells under physiological conditions, creating a distinct translational gap between computational design and in vitro efficacy. To address these limitations, here we engineered an advanced, AI-augmented vaccine discovery pipeline targeting the most virulent components of the MPXV proteome. We systematically screened eight critical viral targets essential for replication, membrane morphogenesis, and host-cell entry to map highly conserved T-cell and B-cell epitopes. Moving beyond standard heuristic filtering, we implemented a high-fidelity deep learning validation layer: ESM-2 protein language models (pLMs) were deployed to calculate pseudo-perplexity scores across chimeric linker junctions (EAAAK, GPGPG) to guarantee structural naturalness, MHCflurry ensemble models successfully verified active intracellular antigen presentation, and structure-informed graph neural networks (GNNs) simulated the physical node-attention dynamics of the immune synapse. Finally, recurrent neural networks (RNNs)-driven mRNA kinetic modeling optimized translation initiation rates and minimum free energy profiles during in silico cloning. This multi-layered pipeline successfully yielded three structurally refined, multi-epitope vaccine constructs optimized for maximum global population coverage. ESM-2 structural validation confirmed exceptionally low perplexity scores at structural junctions, indicating that the engineered chimaeras have native-like stability and a minimized risk of proteolysis. GNN-based immune synapse modeling demonstrated highly stable binding kinetics and robust binding free energies between the target epitopes and human HLA alleles. Furthermore, RNN kinetic optimizations established that the cDNA sequences are optimized for high-yield expression in heterologous expression hosts without risk of ribosomal stalling or translational bottlenecks. This study establishes a deep learning-augmented framework that bridges the gap between theoretical sequence optimization and biopharmaceutical scalability. By validating the structural naturalness, real-world immunogenicity, and manufacturing kinetics of our vaccine chimeras, this framework presents a robust, proactive paradigm for rapid vaccine architecture against emerging orthopoxvirus threats.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 猴痘病毒(MPXV)的再次流行凸显了开发可扩展且对突变具有抗性的对策的迫切需求。传统经验性疫苗的缓慢开发周期阻碍了其发现,而常规疫苗学往往产生高假阳性率,因为其依赖静态、线性序列筛选。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究设计了一个先进的、AI增强的疫苗发现流程,针对MPXV蛋白组中最致命的组分。
elements_zh.methods: 该流程系统筛选了八个关键的病毒靶标,这些靶标对于病毒复制、膜形态发生和宿主细胞进入至关重要,以绘制高度保守的T细胞和B细胞表位。部署了ESM-2蛋白质语言模型、MHCflurry集成模型和基于结构的图神经网络,以验证结构自然性、现实免疫原性和制造动力学。
elements_zh.main_results: 多层管道成功生成了三个结构优化的、多表位疫苗构建体,这些构建体针对全球人口的最大覆盖进行了优化。ESM-2结构验证确认了异常低的困惑度分数,表明类似天然的稳定性。基于GNN的免疫突触建模显示了高度稳定的结合动力学和强大的结合自由能。基于RNN的动力学优化表明,cDNA序列在高产表达方面进行了优化,而不会导致核糖体停滞的风险。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究建立了一个深度学习增强的框架,弥合了理论序列优化与生物制药可扩展性之间的差距。通过验证疫苗嵌合体的结构自然性、现实免疫原性和制造动力学,该框架提供了一种稳健且主动的范式,用于快速构建针对新兴正痘病毒威胁的疫苗架构。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该框架可用于快速开发针对新兴正痘病毒威胁的疫苗,增强全球应对和响应能力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究未报告局限性或证据强度评估。

title: Severe ocular mpox in an immunocompetent patient
abstract: Mpox, formerly known as monkeypox, is caused by Monkeypox virus (MPXV) and has been associated since 2022 with exanthematous illness in men who have sex with men (MSM), including HIV-negative individuals without prior MPXV vaccination. 1 , 2 The clinical course is usually self-limited, with cutaneous and mucosal involvement. 4 , 10 , 12 Severe forms, including keratoconjunctivitis and corneal ulcers, are uncommon and have mainly been linked to immunosuppression. 2 , 3 , 5 , 10 , 12 , 14 We report a 20-year-old MSM male, HIV-negative, immunocompetent, and using pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP). He presented with generalized exanthema, right ocular pain, conjunctival injection, tearing, and periorbital cellulitis. 1 , 2 , 5 , 10 , 14 Ophthalmologic evaluation confirmed severe keratoconjunctivitis with progressive corneal ulcers. 5 , 6 , 7 , 10 , 11 , 14 MPXV PCR was positive in skin and corneal samples. 1 , 2 , 10 , 14 This case highlights the potential for severe ocular disease in a young, otherwise healthy patient and underscores the need for high clinical suspicion, early ophthalmologic assessment, and timely antiviral therapy.

analysis.study_design_and_population: This case report describes a 20-year-old immunocompetent MSM male, HIV-negative, and using pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP), who presented with generalized exanthema and severe ocular symptoms, including right ocular pain, conjunctival injection, tearing, and periorbital cellulitis.
analysis.methods: MPXV PCR testing was conducted on skin and corneal samples to confirm the presence of the monkeypox virus.

analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The case demonstrates that severe ocular disease can occur in an immunocompetent individual, challenging the previous assumption that such complications are primarily linked to immunosuppression.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This case underscores the importance of maintaining high clinical suspicion for mpox virus in immunocompetent patients and emphasizes the need for early ophthalmologic assessment and timely antiviral therapy.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is a single-case report, which limits the generalizability of the findings. However, the evidence is strong due to the direct confirmation of MPXV infection through PCR testing and the detailed clinical description.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old immunocompetent MSM male, HIV-negative, and using pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP), who presented with generalized exanthema and severe ocular symptoms, including right ocular pain, conjunctival injection, tearing, and periorbital cellulitis. Ophthalmologic evaluation confirmed severe keratoconjunctivitis with progressive corneal ulcers, and MPXV PCR was positive in both skin and corneal samples. The case highlights the potential for severe ocular disease in immunocompetent individuals, challenging the previous assumption that such complications are primarily linked to immunosuppression. This finding has important implications for clinical suspicion, early ophthalmologic assessment, and timely antiviral therapy in mpox virus infections. elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本病例报告描述了一名20岁的免疫功能正常的MSM男性,HIV阴性,并使用暴露前预防(PrEP),他出现了全身性出疹和严重的眼部症状,包括右眼疼痛、结膜充血、流泪和眶周蜂窝织炎。

elements_zh.main_results: 眼科评估确认了严重的角膜结膜炎并伴有进行性角膜溃疡,且MPXV PCR在皮肤和角膜样本中均为阳性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该病例表明,严重眼部疾病可以在免疫功能正常的个体中发生,这挑战了之前认为此类并发症主要与免疫抑制相关的假设。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该病例强调了在免疫功能正常患者中保持对猴痘病毒的高度临床怀疑的重要性,并突出了早期眼科评估和及时抗病毒药物治疗的必要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究是一项单个病例报告研究,这限制了研究结果的普遍适用性。然而,由于通过PCR检测直接确认了MPXV感染,并且有详细的临床描述,证据是强有力的。

title: Investigating the deterministic and stochastic dynamics of Monkeypox: a hybrid numerical approach using spectral method and feedforward neural networks
abstract: Monkeypox (Mpox) has recently emerged as a serious threat to human health. Multiple outbreaks of human Mpox have been reported in Africa and North America over the past few years. This study presents a comprehensive computational analysis of Mpox dynamics using a two-model approach. Firstly, a deterministic model is formulated to study the transmission dynamics of Mpox. A basic analysis of the model is conducted, and the corresponding threshold parameter is evaluated. The model’s sensitivity is discussed in detail to study the effect of different parameters on disease incidence. To capture the inherent randomness in disease dynamics, the deterministic model is extended to a stochastic case by incorporating the Brownian motion, which is solved numerically by the Legendre spectral collocation method (LSCM). The criteria for a global positive solution and disease extinction are presented. Comparison of the two frameworks show that while the deterministic model provides a clear baseline threshold for disease persistence, the stochastic model additionally reveals a noise-dependent extinction regime ( \(\mathcal {R}_0^{S}<1\) ) that has no deterministic counterpart, indicating that the stochastic approach yields more conservative and realistic short-term outbreak forecasts in the presence of environmental noise. The application of a Feedforward Neural Network (FFNN) further enriches the approach by simulating the complex interactions within Mpox dynamics, offering an advanced computational modeling framework. The simulation of FFNN-based predictions shows excellent convergence, with minimal gradient values, small learning rates \(\mu \) , and near-zero error distribution, demonstrating the significance of the proposed neuro-computing technique. A perfect correlation of ( \(R = 1\) ) is achieved for the deterministic model, while a correlation of ( \(R = 0.99\) ) is obtained for the stochastic model. The mean squared and mean absolute errors of FFNN approach remain extremely low, ranging from \(10^{-5}\) to \(10^{-9}\) for the deterministic model and from \(10^{-2}\) to \(10^{-7}\) for the stochastic model, confirming accuracy comparable to the LSCM while maintaining strong generalization across training, validation and test datasets.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 猴痘(猴痘)最近已成为对人类健康的重大威胁。本研究旨在采用混合数值方法,探讨猴痘的确定性和随机性动态。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用双模型方法,对猴痘的动态进行了全面的计算分析。确定性模型被建立以研究猴痘的动态。过去几年中,非洲和北美地区已报告多起人类猴痘病例。
elements_zh.methods: 通过引入布朗运动,将确定性模型扩展为随机模型,并采用勒让德谱配置方法(LSCM)进行数值求解。应用前馈神经网络(FFNN)进一步丰富了该方法,通过模拟猴痘动态中的复杂相互作用。
elements_zh.main_results: 两个框架的比较表明,虽然确定性模型提供了疾病持续的明确基线阈值,但随机模型还揭示了一个与噪声相关的灭绝机制(\(\mathcal {R}_0^{S}<1\)),这在确定性模型中并不存在。基于FFNN的预测模拟显示出良好的收敛性,梯度值极小,学习率\(\mu\)较小,误差分布接近于零。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在存在环境噪声的情况下,随机方法能够提供更为保守和现实的短期暴发预测。FFNN方法的均方误差和平均绝对误差均保持极低水平,证实了其准确性与LSCM相当,同时在训练、验证和测试数据集上保持了强大的泛化能力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为短期暴发预测提供了一个更准确和现实的框架,可以为疾病控制和预防的公共卫生策略提供信息。所提出的神经计算技术为研究猴痘动态提供了一个先进的计算建模框架。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于计算模型,未涉及实证数据收集。证据来源于模拟和理论分析,这可能在捕捉现实世界复杂性方面存在局限。由于依赖于基于模型的方法,研究结果的可信度中等。

abstract_zh: 猴痘(猴痘)最近已成为对人类健康的重大威胁。过去几年中,非洲和北美地区已报告多起人类猴痘病例。本研究采用双模型方法,对猴痘的动态进行了全面的计算分析。首先,建立了一个确定性模型以研究猴痘的动态。对模型进行了基本分析,并评估了相应的阈值参数。详细讨论了模型的敏感性,以研究不同参数对疾病发病率的影响。为了捕捉疾病动态中的固有随机性,将确定性模型扩展为随机模型,通过引入布朗运动并采用勒让德谱配置方法(LSCM)进行数值求解。提出了全局正解和疾病灭绝的标准。两个框架的比较表明,虽然确定性模型提供了疾病持续的明确基线阈值,但随机模型还揭示了一个与噪声相关的灭绝机制(\(\mathcal {R}_0^{S}<1\)),这在确定性模型中并不存在,表明随机方法在存在环境噪声的情况下,能够提供更为保守和现实的短期暴发预测。应用前馈神经网络(FFNN)进一步丰富了该方法,通过模拟猴痘动态中的复杂相互作用,提供了一个先进的计算建模框架。基于FFNN的预测模拟显示出良好的收敛性,梯度值极小,学习率\(\mu\)较小,误差分布接近于零,这证明了所提出的神经计算技术的重要性。确定性模型实现了完美的相关性(\(R = 1\)),而随机模型获得了相关性(\(R = 0.99\))。FFNN方法的均方误差和平均绝对误差均保持极低水平,确定性模型的误差范围为\(10^{-5}\)至\(10^{-9}\),随机模型的误差范围为\(10^{-2}\)至\(10^{-7}\),证实了其准确性与LSCM相当,同时在训练、验证和测试数据集上保持了强大的泛化能力。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 猴痘(猴痘)最近已成为对人类健康的重大威胁。本研究旨在采用混合数值方法,探讨猴痘的确定性和随机性动态。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用双模型方法,对猴痘的动态进行了全面的计算分析。确定性模型被建立以研究猴痘的动态。过去几年中,非洲和北美地区已报告多起人类猴痘病例。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过引入布朗运动,将确定性模型扩展为随机模型,并采用勒让德谱配置方法(LSCM)进行数值求解。应用前馈神经网络(FFNN)进一步丰富了该方法,通过模拟猴痘动态中的复杂相互作用。
analysis_zh.main_results: 两个框架的比较表明,虽然确定性模型提供了疾病持续的明确基线阈值,但随机模型还揭示了一个与噪声相关的灭绝机制(\(\mathcal {R}_0^{S}<1\)),这在确定性模型中并不存在。基于FFNN的预测模拟显示出良好的收敛性,梯度值极小,学习率\(\mu\)较小,误差分布接近于零。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在存在环境噪声的情况下,随机方法能够提供更为保守和现实的短期暴发预测。FFNN方法的均方误差和平均绝对误差均保持极低水平,证实了其准确性与LSCM相当,同时在训练、验证和测试数据集上保持了强大的泛化能力。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为短期暴发预测提供了一个更准确和现实的框架,可以为疾病控制和预防的公共卫生策略提供信息。所提出的神经计算技术为研究猴痘动态提供了一个先进的计算建模框架。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于计算模型,未涉及实证数据收集。证据来源于模拟和理论分析,这可能在捕捉现实世界复杂性方面存在局限。由于依赖于基于模型的方法,研究结果的可信度中等。

title: HECA-YOLOv11: A High-Accuracy Hybrid Attention Network for Real-Time Monkeypox Skin Lesion Detection with Interpretability
abstract: Introduction: The global outbreak risk of monkeypox necessitates efficient diagnostic tools. Current methods are slow and struggle to differentiate similar skin lesions, while deep learning models lack both accuracy and interpretability for multi-class classification. This study aims to develop a high-performance, real-time screening tool for early detection of monkeypox and similar conditions. Methods: This study proposes an enhanced architecture that incorporates the Highly Efficient Channel Attention (HECA) mechanism into YOLOv11 to improve feature selection. HECA performs Global Average Pooling (GAP) and Max Average Pooling (MAP) on input feature maps. Using spatial transformations and pixel-domain enhancements, the research establishes and augments a four-class dataset containing monkeypox, measles, chickenpox, and normal skin images. Gradient-Weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) generates heatmaps for lesion localization visualization, while a PyQt5-based interactive diagnostic interface streamlines clinical workflows. Results: Experimental results demonstrate the proposed model’s superior performance compared to existing approaches (EfficientNet-v2-l, GoogLeNet, ResNet50, VGG19, MobileNetv2, DenseNet201, and YOLOv11s) on the test set, with enhanced detection speed, accuracy (98.9%), precision (99%), recall (99.3%), and F1-score (99.1%). HECA-YOLOv11 outperforms SE-YOLOv11 and ECA-YOLOv11 by over 5.1% across all evaluation metrics. Heatmap analysis confirms the model’s focus on lesion regions, aligning with medical reasoning. Discussion: The integrated attention mechanism and interpretability techniques effectively address key limitations in automated skin lesion detection. The high performance and low latency signify a major advancement towards reliable clinical decision support, with important implications for early outbreak containment. Conclusion: The HECA-YOLOv11 framework provides a highly accurate and efficient tool for early monkeypox screening. Its standardized interface holds significant potential to accelerate public health responses and improve global control of emerging infectious diseases.
journal: Recent Advances in Computer Science and Communications

title: Healthcare Workers’ Preparedness for Monkeypox Pandemic Response in SubSaharan Africa: A Rapid Review Investigating the Knowledge Gap
abstract: Background: Mpox is a zoonotic viral disease caused by an Orthopoxvirus endemic to sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), where its resurgence underscores the urgent need for improved preparedness among health care workers (HCWs). Despite the potential of a One Health approach, current implementations remain fragmented. This rapid review synthesises evidence on HCWs' knowledge, attitudes, information sources, and barriers to preparedness regarding Mpox in SSA to identify training needs and policy implications. Methods: Following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines, PubMed and ScienceDirect were searched using MeSH terms and Boolean operators for studies published between 2000 and 2024. Studies assessing HCW knowledge, attitudes, or preparedness for Mpox in SSA with full-text availability in English or French were included; those involving non-HCW populations, conducted outside SSA, or lacking primary data were excluded. Two reviewers independently screened and extracted data using a standardised template; quality was assessed using the JBI Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical CrossSectional Studies. Results: Five studies from 388 records were included (Cameroon, Ethiopia, Nigeria, DRC; n = 1,672 HCWs). Only 46.8% of HCWs demonstrated adequate Mpox knowledge. Barriers included reliance on social media and limited access to formal training. Positive attitudes towards prevention correlated with higher knowledge levels. Conclusion: Fewer than half of SSA HCWs demonstrate adequate Mpox knowledge despite a regional case fatality rate nearly ten times the global average; positive attitudes are not translating into clinical preparedness, reflecting a critical intention-action gap; and social media dominates as an information source, underscoring the need for peer-reviewed alternatives within a One Health training framework.
journal: Journal of Clinical Virology and Translational Research

title: Pattern recognition receptors and divergent disease severity in zoonotic viral infections.
abstract: Zoonotic viruses continue to emerge unpredictably, cross species barriers, and inflict major health, economic, and ecological burdens. Recent outbreaks of SARS-CoV-2, H5N1 avian influenza virus (AIV), monkeypox, and Zika virus underscore the unpredictability of viral emergence and the urgent need to understand host/pathogen interactions. This review focuses on how innate immune sensing via pattern recognition receptors (PRRs) shapes disease severity across different species. While PRRs initiate antiviral defenses (interferons, ISGs), inflammatory cytokines, and programmed cell death, host outcomes diverge widely, shaped by genetic variation in PRR pathways and their regulators. Dysregulated inflammatory responses and inflammatory cell death can contribute substantially to severe disease independently of viral load, as demonstrated in influenza and coronavirus infections. Viral effectors that suppress or alter PRR signaling can show species-specific efficacy, and these mismatches can be critical determinants of disease when viruses jump hosts. Using avian influenza as an example, we highlight how disease outcomes vary with viral strain, host species, response timing, and tissue context. Overall, we propose that differential disease severity across host species reflects the balance among PRR-mediated resistance, the efficiency of viral immune evasion in the relevant host, and innate disease-tolerance mechanisms that limit tissue damage. Understanding these dynamics could enhance our ability to predict zoonotic emergence and mitigate the impact of viral pandemics.

title_zh: 模式识别受体与人兽共患病病毒感染中不同的疾病严重程度
source_body_en: Zoonotic viruses continue to emerge unpredictably, cross species barriers, and inflict major health, economic, and ecological burdens. Recent outbreaks of SARS-CoV-2, H5N1 avian influenza virus (AIV), monkeypox, and Zika virus underscore the unpredictability of viral emergence and the urgent need to understand host/pathogen interactions. This review focuses on how innate immune sensing via pattern recognition receptors (PRRs) shapes disease severity across different species. While PRRs initiate antiviral defenses (interferons, ISGs), inflammatory cytokines, and programmed cell death, host outcomes diverge widely, shaped by genetic variation in PRR pathways and their regulators. Dysregulated inflammatory responses and inflammatory cell death can contribute substantially to severe disease independently of viral load, as demonstrated in influenza and coronavirus infections. Viral effectors that suppress or alter PRR signaling can show species-specific efficacy, and these mismatches can be critical determinants of disease when viruses jump hosts. Using avian influenza as an example, we highlight how disease outcomes vary with viral strain, host species, response timing, and tissue context. Overall, we propose that differential disease severity across host species reflects the balance among PRR-mediated resistance, the efficiency of viral immune evasion in the relevant host, and innate disease-tolerance mechanisms that limit tissue damage. Understanding these dynamics could enhance our ability to predict zoonotic emergence and mitigate the impact of viral pandemics.
abstract_zh: 人兽共患病病毒持续以不可预测的方式出现,跨越物种屏障,并造成重大的健康、经济和生态负担。最近对SARS-CoV-2、H5N1禽流感病毒(AIV)、猴痘和寨卡病毒的暴发突显了病毒出现的不可预测性以及迫切需要理解宿主/病原体相互作用的重要性。本综述重点探讨了模式识别受体(PRRs)介导的先天免疫感应如何在不同物种中影响疾病严重程度。尽管PRRs启动了抗病毒药物抗病毒防御(干扰素、ISGs)、炎症细胞因子和程序性细胞死亡,但宿主结果差异显著,这取决于PRRs通路及其调控因子的遗传变异。失调的炎症反应和炎症性细胞死亡可以独立于病毒载量显著导致严重疾病,如流感和冠状病毒感染所展示的。能够抑制或改变PRRs信号传导的病毒效应因子可能在不同物种中表现出特定的效果,这些不匹配可能是病毒跨物种溢出时疾病发生的关键决定因素。以禽流感为例,我们强调了疾病结果如何因病毒株、宿主物种、反应时机和组织背景而有所不同。总体而言,我们认为不同宿主物种中不同的疾病严重程度反映了模式识别受体介导的抗性、病毒在相关宿主中免疫逃逸的效率以及限制组织损伤的先天疾病耐受机制之间的平衡。理解这些动态变化可能有助于我们预测人兽共患病的出现并减轻病毒大流行的冲击。
